description.value: The study compared GM volume VBM results from FSL and SPM in ALS-FTD patients and unaffected neurologic controls, using Freesurfer cortical measures as a comparison.

spans.text: We compared GM VBM changes between ALS-FTD patients and unaffected neurologic controls using two popular image analysis software programs (SPM and FSL), with Freesurfer’s cortical thickness and volume measures.

value: the differences in statistical parametric maps between FSL and SPM were due to use of the threshold free cluster enhancement (TFCE) method in FSL but not in SPM

spans.text: We hypothesized that the differences in statistical parametric maps between the two softwares were due to use of the threshold free cluster enhancement (TFCE) method in FSL but not in SPM.
